angle.prompt_en: Full-body shot from the front at eye level, camera about three meters away, 35mm equivalent, subject fully visible head to feet, subtle natural handheld sway.

angle.fungsi: Produk utuh dengan karakter lebih dekat
angle.prompt_en: Medium-full shot from the front, framed from the knees up, eye level, 35mm equivalent, subtle handheld.

angle.fungsi: Produk dipegang atau ditunjukkan di dada
angle.prompt_en: Medium shot as a half-body shot, eye level, 35mm equivalent, the subject holding or presenting the product at mid-body height, label facing the camera.

angle.fungsi: Detail dekat wajah: kerah, aksesori, kemasan di dekat wajah
angle.prompt_en: Medium close-up as an upper-body shot, eye level, 50mm equivalent, gentle background softness, the product detail near the face clearly visible.

angle.fungsi: Satu detail produk yang ditunjuk atau disentuh karakter
angle.risiko: AI mengarang detail yang tidak ada di referensi
angle.prompt_en: Close-up of one product detail, 50-85mm equivalent at f/2.8, the subject's hand pointing to or touching the detail, background softly blurred, the product exactly as in the reference.

angle.risiko: Hanya bila foto close-up ada. Risiko tekstur karangan tinggi
angle.prompt_en: Extreme close-up of a surface texture, 85mm equivalent, steady, only as shown in the close-up reference.
Three-quarter view, camera 45 degrees to the subject's side, medium-full, eye level, 35mm equivalent; the subject turns her body while the camera does not orbit.
Side profile view at 90 degrees, eye level, 35mm equivalent, the subject stands naturally without spinning.

angle.fungsi: Konstruksi belakang bila foto belakang ada
angle.risiko: Dilarang bila tidak ada foto belakang
angle.prompt_en: Back view, medium-full, the subject slightly looks back over the shoulder toward the camera, no spin.
Low angle with the camera near the floor looking slightly up at the feet and legs, 35mm equivalent, f/4, steady.

angle.fungsi: Produk di meja atau isi tas
angle.prompt_en: High angle looking down about 35 degrees, medium shot, 50mm equivalent, moderate background blur.

angle.fungsi: Tampilan flat lay dan isi set
angle.prompt_en: Top-down shot straight above the tabletop, 35mm equivalent, steady with a very slight natural hand tremor.

angle.fungsi: Demonstrasi pemakaian dengan wajah tidak terlihat
angle.prompt_en: First-person POV of the subject's own hands demonstrating the product at mid-body height, the face not visible, 24-28mm equivalent, natural handheld shake, natural fingers.

angle.risiko: Paling berisiko: model mengarang sisi yang tidak terlihat (dokumen kursus)
angle.prompt_en: Over-the-shoulder view looking past the subject's shoulder toward the product in front of her, 50mm equivalent, f/2.8.
Front-camera selfie at arm's length, the frame cutting across the chin, one arm extending diagonally from the lower left and cropped at the wrist, 24mm equivalent.
Mirror selfie with natural handheld micro sway, the subject's face clearly visible in the mirror.
Close-up with a subtle dutch angle of about 10 degrees, eye level, 85mm equivalent, f/1.8.

angle.risiko: Produk terlalu kecil untuk panel produk
angle.prompt_en: Wide establishing shot, 35mm equivalent at f/8, deep focus so everything is sharp from foreground to background.
Handheld follow shot of the subject walking slowly toward the camera, 35mm equivalent, natural footstep bounce.

gerak_kamera.deskripsi: Kamera nyaris tanpa gerak, hanya getar tangan sangat halus. Untuk detail dan flat lay.
Getar dan sway kecil, tidak teratur, tidak mekanis, seperti ponsel yang dipegang santai.
Getar, sway, dan micro-reframing lebih terlihat. Untuk hook dan gaya amatir mentah.
